title: Spice Bazaar Cook
premise: A long master-apprentice drama in the turmeric kitchen and open spice stall. Xiaoqiao and A Dengbing are easily confused; the brass mortar goes intact→bowl cracked→welded restored; the spice camel cart burns and must be avoided; count memory, false friends, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.
_comment: Author layer: humans only write entities + state machines + per-scene timelines (present + handwritten action + semantic events). op/gap/probe/forbidden are derived by complete_gt.py.

states.prime_cook: Spice-bazaar cook Feng Deng in his forties, short beard, turmeric apron and white short sleeves, copper-bell bracelet on his right wrist, sharp eyes.
states.scalded_weary: The same Feng Deng: apron edges scorched, right forearm wrapped in burn gauze, leaning on the stove as he moves slowly, eyes heavy.
states.deceased: Feng Deng has closed his eyes in death, lying still on the back-kitchen plank bed, face peaceful, breath gone.

states.young_apprentice: Young Xiaoqiao: a lean kitchen helper of fourteen or fifteen, jade-green cardamom pod tucked behind one ear, oversized turmeric apron, bright stubborn eyes.
states.adult_successor: Adult Xiaoqiao: a cook in his twenties, shoulders broader, still with the jade-green cardamom pod behind his ear, apron now a good fit, eyes steady.

states.intact: A heavy brass mortar, meander pattern carved around the rim, pestle head polished bright, inner walls stained turmeric and clove.
states.bowl_cracked: The same brass mortar burst with glaring cracks, pestle head chipped, spice crust inside dried and flaking.
states.welded_restored: The brass mortar cracks welded and ground smooth, pestle head recast, inner walls repolished and usable again.

states.intact: A cowhide-covered recipe booklet, dried-chili and cinnamon diagrams clipped inside, handwriting neat.
states.oil_stained: The same recipe booklet soaked through with sesame oil, cover sticky, ink blurred into clumps.

states.intact: A two-wheeled spice cart painted with camel-bell motifs, tiered tin jars and hemp sacks in the bed, colorful cloth strips wound on the shafts.
states.overturned_burned: The spice camel cart ignited by stove fire: shafts charred black, tin jars burst, only twisted iron hoops remain.

states.young_rival: Kitchen helper A Dengbing, face nearly identical to Xiaoqiao's, but purple-red chili string wound on his wrist and smoke-gray short jacket, bold expression.
states.remade_appearance: Remade A Dengbing still wears the purple-red chili string, short jacket now deep brown, expression darker.

E7.name: turmeric kitchen
E7.appearance: The turmeric kitchen deep in the bazaar: brick stoves breathing flame, copper ladles and dried-chili strings on the wall, spice heat thick in the air.

E8.name: open spice stall
E8.appearance: The open spice stall at the lane mouth, canvas awning over tin jars and bamboo trays, turmeric-powder lines on the ground.

E9.name: pottery-store lane
E9.appearance: A narrow lane between pottery-store shelves, clay jars stacked high on both sides, damp-proof lime scattered on the ground, heavy shadow.

E10.name: old market ruin stove
E10.appearance: Ruins of an old market stove, brick hearth half collapsed, plaster peeling, empty tin jars piled in a corner.

E11.name: kitchen memorial plaque
E11.appearance: A brass memorial plaque nailed to a kitchen brick pillar, engraved with Feng Deng and the year the kitchen opened, edges verdigris.

E12.name: tin spice jars
E12.appearance: Three tin spice jars in a row, labeled cumin, cinnamon, and fennel.

E13.name: red delivery cart
E13.appearance: A brand-new red three-wheeled delivery cart with a cooler box in the bed, no camel-bell motif, nothing like the spice camel cart.

E14.name: market sanitarian
E14.appearance: A lean market sanitarian in a white cap and pale-blue smock, build somewhat like Feng Deng's, but a health-department badge on his chest.

E15.name: oil lamps
E15.appearance: A row of five brass oil lamps hanging from iron hooks on the kitchen beam, bowls polished bright.

E16.name: opening bells
E16.appearance: Two opening bells under the awning eaves, clappers dented from use, two clear rings at market open.

E17.name: Xiaojiao
E17.appearance: New dishwashing apprentice Xiaojiao, light-orange headscarf and fresh apron; at a glance somewhat like young Xiaoqiao, but sharper chin and shy eyes.

E18.name: stone mortar
E18.appearance: A bluestone mortar, shape somewhat like the brass mortar but bulkier, no meander carving, no brass sheen.

E19.name: gray flat cart
E19.appearance: A gray-blue grocery flat cart, wide and low, no camel-bell motif, not the spice camel cart.

features.E2: Xiaoqiao: jade-green cardamom pod behind the ear, turmeric apron.
features.E6: A Dengbing: face nearly identical to Xiaoqiao's, but purple-red chili string on the wrist and smoke-gray short jacket.

lookalike_pairs.note: Hard confuse sample: jade-green cardamom pod vs purple-red chili string.

scenes.setting: Kitchen at dusk (introduce five oil lamps · two opening bells)
actions: At dusk, Feng Deng ties his turmeric apron and walks into the turmeric kitchen, lifting the brass mortar to test-grind.

actions.action: A row of five brass oil lamps hangs from the kitchen beam; Feng Deng wipes each bowl clean.
Two opening bells hang under the awning eaves; Feng Deng taps them lightly, rings crisp.

actions: Feng Deng checks the brass mortar pestle and meander rim, confirming no cracks.
Through the kitchen door gap, Feng Deng looks toward the bustling night-market lights at the lane mouth.

actions.action: The intact brass mortar rests on the stove, rim catching warm lamplight.

actions: Feng Deng sits by the woodpile and takes a sip of yogurt.
Hawking rises in the distance; he relights the stove fire.
He scatters a pinch of cumin into the pot; spice heat bursts at once.
Feng Deng opens the cowhide recipe booklet and notes today's curry-base ratio.
He sketches chili and cinnamon proportions on the booklet.
Feng Deng closes the recipe booklet and tucks it into a stove drawer.

actions.action: The brass mortar grinding clings to his cheek.

actions: He tears a corner of hemp paper and wipes dust from the scale pan.

scenes.setting: Spice stall greets apprentice (introduce three tin jars)

actions.action: At dawn on the open spice stall, Feng Deng meets the spice camel cart being pushed in.
Young Xiaoqiao steadies the spice camel cart, jade-green cardamom pod behind his ear swaying slightly.
Feng Deng points at three tin spice jars on the stall and teaches Xiaoqiao cumin from fennel.
Xiaoqiao crouches by the turmeric-powder line, curious, sniffing dried lemon in a bamboo tray.
Feng Deng tells Xiaoqiao that two rings of the opening bells mean fire on the stove.
Xiaoqiao looks back at the intact spice camel cart, eyes full of longing.

actions: Canvas awning snapping, the two walk toward the turmeric kitchen.
In the pottery-store lane, A Dengbing with purple-red chili string on his wrist turns from jar shadows.
A Dengbing steps slowly along the lime line, smoke-gray short jacket standing out.
He passes a jar-delivery worker; chili string flashes in jar reflections.
A Dengbing taps a shelf stack, checking layers are stable.
He crosses the lane end and heads toward the dishwashing room.
On the open spice stall, Xiaoqiao and A Dengbing stand side by side: one with jade-green cardamom pod behind the ear, one with purple-red chili string on the wrist.
Xiaoqiao hands a tasting spoon to A Dengbing; they glance at each other briefly.
A Dengbing straightens Xiaoqiao's oversized apron tie, then looks away.
They walk opposite ways down the lane, figures crossing under the canvas awning.
Spatula clatter rises; only tin jars lightly touching remain at the stall.
Months later at night, Feng Deng keeps watch alone in the turmeric kitchen.

actions.action: He opens the recipe booklet; the cover is soaked with sesame oil, sticky, ink blurred.

actions: Feng Deng wipes oil crust from the brass mortar's outer wall with a rag.
Leaning in the door gap, he looks toward a lone wild lamp at the dark lane mouth.

actions.action: The brass mortar rests on the stove, pestle head slightly dulled.

actions: An opening bell half-chimes in the night wind, then falls silent.
When spring spice shipments arrive, Feng Deng grinds ratios day after day in the kitchen.
Another rainy night, he wraps his apron tight and guards the brass mortar.
Midsummer noon, stove heat bakes the brick wall; he rotates to cool down.
Autumn fog thick, oil-lamp light struggles through spice smoke.
On New Year's Eve, Feng Deng alone fills the recipe record to the last page.
Early spring, he recalibrates the scale and keeps tasting.
Before the rainy season, Feng Deng reinforces damp-proof lime in the pottery store.
After frost, he adds a small jar of lard in a kitchen corner.
Another year before Eid, he checks tin-jar seals jar by jar.
On a snowy night the stove rests; Feng Deng keeps one oil lamp burning till dawn.
After Awakening of Insects, he rehangs dried chili strings.
Around Qingming, he sweeps ash piled at the old market ruin stove entrance.
At Grain Rain, he teaches a young apprentice to identify new dried-lemon slices.
On a Start-of-Summer night, he watches a slow-simmer broth reduce.
Feng Deng swaps stove firewood and straightens the flame.
He checks the exhaust filter and shakes off spice dust.

actions.action: He lifts the intact brass mortar again and gives three short grinds.

actions: Camel bells drift from the lane mouth; he lifts his head to listen.
Feng Deng pours waste oil into a clay jar and covers it.
At midday rest he drinks tea under the awning, steam curling past dried-chili strings.
In the afternoon he returns to the stove and stir-fries another curry base.
At sunset he seals the stove and locks the spice cabinet.
Before nightfall he patrols the pottery store once more, checking for rats.

scenes.setting: Spice stall patrol (recall tin jars · gray flat cart false friend)
actions: At first light, Feng Deng patrols the open spice stall; the spice camel cart still stands under the awning.

actions.action: He crouches to check whether cloth strips on the spice camel cart shafts are loose.
On the stall, the same three tin spice jars still sit in a row.
A gray flat cart rolls past the lane mouth, wide and low, with no camel-bell motif.
Feng Deng stands before the stall, noting cinnamon sticks dampened overnight.
He repacks the hemp sacks on the spice camel cart.

actions: A distant mosque call to prayer drifts faintly.
At night Feng Deng returns to the turmeric kitchen and opens the oil-stained recipe booklet.
He copies today's tasting notes at the usual ratio.

actions.action: He gives the brass mortar a brief grind; aroma catches on the booklet's sticky cover.

actions: He wipes soot from the inside of an oil-lamp bowl.
Lane wind rises; canvas awning rustles lightly.
Feng Deng dims half the row of oil lamps, leaving only the one at the stove.
In a downpour the stove flame suddenly flares; the turmeric kitchen turns frantic.
Hot oil spatters; oil lamps sway violently.

actions.action: As Feng Deng fights the fire, the brass mortar bursts with cracks, pestle head chipped.
Under the awning, the spice camel cart catches stray sparks and smokes heavily.
Flame licks the shafts; the spice camel cart overturns and burns, tin jars bursting.
Feng Deng grips the cracked brass mortar and will not let go.

actions: Someone throws water; the lane fills with charred spice and steam.

scenes.setting: After the disaster (cart indirect reference · oil-lamp recall)

actions.action: Next day after rain, Feng Deng stands in the kitchen staring at the bowl-cracked brass mortar.
He runs a finger along the cracks, expression dim.
On a blank page of the recipe booklet he writes the date the spice camel cart burned.
A loading diagram for the spice camel cart still hangs on the wall; Feng Deng stares a long while.
He takes one of five oil lamps from the beam and sits alone in its faint light.
The cracked brass mortar rests on the stove like a silent wound.

actions: Sweeping sounds rise in the distance; charred scraps are gathered into a pile.

scenes.setting: Welding the mortar (third state · stone mortar false friend)
actions: Weeks later, Feng Deng brings a coppersmith to repair the brass mortar.

actions.action: From a corner he moves a stone mortar, somewhat like the brass mortar but bulkier, no meander carving.

actions: The coppersmith welds the cracks and grinds the pestle head anew.

actions.action: Inner walls polished, the brass mortar is usable again.

actions: He test-grinds briefly; aroma releases evenly once more.
Feng Deng puts the stone mortar back in the corner, no longer confused.

scenes.setting: False friends: delivery cart and sanitarian

actions.action: A red delivery cart rolls into the open spice stall, nothing like the burned spice camel cart.
A market sanitarian in white cap and pale-blue smock enters the stall and talks beside Feng Deng; their builds are similar.
The sanitarian points at the red delivery cart, explaining a temporary delivery arrangement.
The delivery cart leaves; Feng Deng alone watches from the stall.

actions: He straightens the tin spice jars and walks back to the kitchen.

actions.action: In the pottery-store lane comes dishwashing apprentice Xiaojiao in a light-orange headscarf, at a glance somewhat like young Xiaoqiao.
Xiaojiao tries scrubbing jars; Feng Deng shakes his head—she is not Xiaoqiao after all.

actions: Xiaojiao bows her head and steps back; only jar shadows remain in the narrow lane.

actions.action: Years later at dusk, Feng Deng with scorched apron edges and gauze on his arm leans on the stove-like hearth at the old market ruin stove.

actions: He looks up at the collapsed brick hearth, gaze far away.

actions.action: In the distance under an awning, two opening bells chime lightly in the wind; Feng Deng stops to listen.

actions: He presses his palm to an empty tin jar, as if saying goodbye.
Lane wind lifts turmeric powder; the ruin stove grows quieter.

actions.action: By day, adult Xiaoqiao returns along the lane, hurrying toward the old market ruin stove.
Xiaoqiao meets scalded-weary Feng Deng under the ruin stove; they support each other.
Beside the back-kitchen plank bed, Xiaoqiao holds Feng Deng's thin hand.
Feng Deng's breath weakens; he finally closes his eyes and passes away.
Outside, spatula clatter stills; lane wind suddenly hushes a moment.
Behind the kitchen door Feng Deng's turmeric apron still hangs; Xiaoqiao reaches out and touches it lightly.
By a brick pillar, adult Xiaoqiao stands before the newly nailed kitchen memorial plaque.
Xiaoqiao's fingertip traces Feng Deng's name carved on the kitchen memorial plaque.
He quietly reads aloud the page number where the spice camel cart burn was recorded, as if answering.

scenes.setting: Mentioning the deceased and destroyed again (indirect avoidance)

actions.action: After the open spice stall is swept clean, Xiaoqiao writes then erases the words for spice camel cart in an empty cart space.
Passing the back-kitchen corridor, he sees Feng Deng's old copper-bell bracelet in a glass case.
In the night, Xiaoqiao softly repeats the stove-fire command Feng Deng taught.

actions: Lane wind passes; Xiaoqiao closes the jade-green cardamom pod tight in his palm.

actions.action: Remade A Dengbing hurries from the pottery store and meets Xiaoqiao under the old market ruin stove for a brief look.

actions: Xiaoqiao and A Dengbing stand side by side by the collapsed stove: one eyes steady, one expression deep.
A Dengbing still wears purple-red chili string on his wrist; Xiaoqiao still has the jade-green cardamom pod behind his ear.
Silent a moment, each turns away from the ruin stove.

scenes._comment: Temporal phrase anchors; no formal entity names; avoid deceased/destroyed.

actions.action: The shot returns to years ago—that youth steadying the camel-bell cart, jade-green cardamom pod behind his ear, appears again.

anchor.phrase: youth steadying camel-bell cart jade-green cardamom pod behind ear

actions.action: The opening moment returns—in the kitchen, a meander-carved brass bowl grinds spice heat for the first time.

anchor.phrase: opening first grind meander-carved brass bowl

actions.action: Flash back to the pottery-store lane—that figure with purple-red chili string on the wrist and smoke-gray short jacket flashes past.

anchor.phrase: lane figure purple-red chili string smoke-gray short jacket

actions.action: Before the eyes again, that row of five small brass oil lamps on the kitchen beam.

anchor.phrase: kitchen beam row of five small brass oil lamps

actions.action: Back to the first meeting at the spice lane mouth under canvas awning, turmeric-powder lines unchanged.

anchor.phrase: first-meeting spice lane mouth under canvas awning

scenes.setting: Closure (booklet long recall · tin jars long recall)

actions.action: Xiaoqiao reopens the oil-stained recipe booklet and walks into the turmeric kitchen.
At the stall, the same three tin spice jars still sit in a row.
Xiaoqiao lifts the welded-restored brass mortar; spice heat rises again.

actions: He tightens his apron tie and nods confirmation as Feng Deng once did.
At dusk in the lane mouth, a new shift of opening bells chime twice lightly.
Xiaoqiao drops today's first spatula stroke at the stove.
